artifact.name: Mobile checkout payment step
artifact.primary_task: Complete payment after reviewing the order total
artifact.notes: Example report with synthetic observations; not a real product audit.

viewports.notes: Used for minimum supported phone width.
Used for common modern phone width.

states.notes: Payment form and order summary were visible.
Submit loading state was visible; full-page loading was not available.
Checkout cannot be empty after cart review.
Card validation error and payment failure banner were available.
Browser keyboard behavior was approximated by shrinking viewport height.
The artifact did not expose a reduced-motion toggle.

summary.short_rationale: The checkout remains generally usable, but the sticky payment CTA overlaps validation feedback on the narrow viewport and reduced-motion behavior was not verified.

checks.notes: Primary total, card fields, and payment CTA remain visible in a predictable order.
Sticky payment CTA covers the bottom line of the card validation error.
Long saved-card name truncates without preserving the final four digits.
Primary CTA and input rows appear to meet common mobile touch guidance; exact hit boxes were not measured.
Placeholder text appears light against the field background; contrast ratio was not measured.
When viewport height is reduced, the CVV field remains visible but the payment CTA is partially obscured.
No reduced-motion setting or emulation was available during this review.

findings.title: Sticky CTA overlaps card validation error on narrow phones

evidence.description: On 360x780, the fixed bottom payment bar covers the second line of the card-number error after submit.
evidence.selector_or_region: bottom payment bar / card number field

findings.impact: Users may not see the recovery instruction and may repeatedly submit the same invalid card number.
findings.recommendation: Reserve bottom padding equal to the sticky CTA height plus safe-area inset, or move field-level errors above the sticky bar when the keyboard/error state is active.

findings.title: Saved-card label truncates before the identifying digits

evidence.description: The saved-card row truncates the card label as 'Corporate travel Visa end...' on the narrow viewport.

findings.impact: Users with multiple cards may not know which payment method is selected.
findings.recommendation: Keep the final four digits in a non-shrinking text span and truncate the nickname before the card network or digits.

findings.title: Placeholder contrast should be measured before release

evidence.description: Placeholder text appears visually faint in light mode, but exact contrast values were not measured.

findings.impact: Users with low vision may confuse placeholders with disabled or unavailable fields.
findings.recommendation: Measure placeholder, helper, and disabled text contrast against the field background and adjust tokens if needed.

unverified.reason: The local artifact did not expose reduced-motion emulation during this review.
unverified.needed_evidence: Run the screen with reduced-motion preference enabled or provide a recording of the reduced-motion path.

unverified.reason: Visual inspection can only flag contrast risk, not prove exact ratios.
unverified.needed_evidence: Measured foreground/background color values for placeholder, helper, error, disabled, and primary CTA states.

recommendations.title: Fix narrow-viewport error overlap
recommendations.action: Add reserved bottom spacing for the sticky CTA and test the payment-error state at 360 px width.
recommendations.success_criteria: Field-level error text remains fully visible with the sticky CTA and simulated keyboard present.

recommendations.title: Protect payment-method identity under truncation
recommendations.action: Make final four digits non-shrinking and truncate the custom card nickname first.
recommendations.success_criteria: The selected card row always shows card network and final four digits at 360 px width.

recommendations.title: Measure contrast tokens
recommendations.action: Capture foreground/background pairs for placeholder, helper, disabled, error, and CTA text.
recommendations.success_criteria: Contrast findings are upgraded from inferred risk to measured pass/fail.
